title: Steven Spielberg to Direct Paul Thomas Anderson's The Heart in Winter Adaptation
excerpt: Cillian Murphy, Jessie Buckley and Mark Rylance are attached to star in the Western adaptation, with a 2028 theatrical release being targeted.
body_md:
Steven Spielberg is developing a Western based on Kevin Barry's 2024 novel The Heart in Winter, with Paul Thomas Anderson writing the screenplay. The project is being developed for Focus Features and is set to star Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy and Mark Rylance.

The novel takes place in the American West in the late nineteenth century and follows two lovers on the run as they try to escape danger and build a different life. The combination of a romantic fugitive story and a harsh frontier setting offers Spielberg a chance to explore a genre he has long wanted to direct.

The collaboration is especially notable because Anderson is best known for writing and directing his own films. For this project, he is writing a screenplay that Spielberg will direct. Both filmmakers will also produce, alongside Kristie Macosko Krieger and Sarah Murphy.

The cast brings together three Academy Award winners. Murphy is known for Oppenheimer, Buckley for Hamnet and Rylance for Bridge of Spies. Their involvement gives the literary adaptation a prominent ensemble even before additional production details have been announced.

The filmmakers are targeting a theatrical release in 2028, but no specific date has been confirmed. The Heart in Winter is the title of the source novel, and the final film title and precise production schedule remain subject to further announcements.

The project follows Spielberg's recent work on Disclosure Day and his producing involvement with Hamnet. It also represents an unusual creative partnership between two prominent American filmmakers.
seo_title: Spielberg and Paul Thomas Anderson Team for The Heart in Winter
seo_description: Steven Spielberg will direct a Western written by Paul Thomas Anderson, starring Jessie Buckley, Cillian Murphy and Mark Rylance.
